  "name": "proposal-kit",
  "private": true,
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "type": "module",
  "description": "A tiny design system for one solar proposal summary, built so an AI coding tool can't make the costly mistakes quietly. Made-up data.",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "vite",
    "build": "tsc -b && vite build",
    "typecheck": "tsc -b",
    "lint": "eslint .",
    "tokens": "node scripts/check-tokens.mjs",
    "test": "vitest run",
    "check": "npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run tokens && npm run test",
    "storybook": "storybook dev -p 6006",
    "build-storybook": "storybook build -o storybook-static"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@radix-ui/react-separator": "1.2.0",
    "@radix-ui/react-slot": "1.5.0",
    "class-variance-authority": "0.7.1",
    "clsx": "2.1.1",
    "lucide-react": "1.63.0",
    "react": "19.3.1",
    "react-dom": "19.3.1",
    "tailwind-merge": "3.7.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@eslint/js": "10.0.1",
    "@storybook/addon-a11y": "10.6.5",

All money is in whole cents. const proposal = { id: "P-2077", preparedOn: "November 12, 2026", status: "Ready to sign", homeowner: { name: "Maria Okafor", address: "77 Juniper Bend, Lakeport" }, installer: "Brightline Home Solar", system: { panelCount: 18, panelWatts: 410, inverter: "One microinverter per panel", annualKwh: 11_900, }, lineItems: [ { label: "Panels and inverters", cents: 1_395_000 }, { label: "Installation", cents: 645_000 }, { label: "Permits and inspection", cents: 160_000 }, ], downPaymentCents: 200_000, loan: { apr: 6.49, termMonths: 240, monthlyCents: 14_900 }, }; const totalCents = proposal.lineItems.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.cents, 0); // $22,000 const financedCents = totalCents - proposal.downPaymentCents; // $20,000 const totalOfPaymentsCents = proposal.loan.monthlyCents * proposal.loan.termMonths; // $35,760 const systemKw = (proposal.system.panelCount * proposal.system.panelWatts) / 1000; // 7.38 kW const savingsAssumptions: SavingsAssumptions = { annualKwh: proposal.system.annualKwh, ratePerKwhCents: 15, yearlyIncreasePct: 3, years: 25, }; // works out to about $65,080 total, $1,785 the first year const kwFormat = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }); const intFormat = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", { maximumFractionDigits: 0 }); function Row({ label, children, strong = false }: { label: string; children: React.ReactNode; strong?: boolean }) { return (

content.text:
I built the summary page in `src/views/GeneratedSummary.tsx`, but I couldn't run the typecheck, lint, token check or tests, so it's untested. I checked all the numbers by hand.

**Page layout**
- **Header:** proposal P-2077, prepared November 12, 2026, with a "Ready to sign" badge (text plus a check icon), Maria Okafor's name and address, and Brightline Home Solar as installer.
- **Your system:** 7.38 kW, 18 panels at 410 W, one microinverter per panel, and 11,900 kWh a year estimated production.
- **Price:** the three line items, then total $22,000, down payment $2,000 and amount financed $20,000.
- **Financing:** `PaymentLine` shows $149.00 a month with 6.49% APR and 240 months (20 years) on the same line, followed by the total of 240 payments, $35,760.
- **Estimated savings:** `SavingsEstimate` works the figure out from the stated assumptions (11,900 kWh, $0.15 per kWh, rising 3% a year, 25 years). It shows about $65,080 total and $1,785 the first year, with the "Estimated" label, the assumptions and "Not a guarantee."

**How it's built**
- All money is stored in whole cents and shown through `Money`. Colours and spacing come only from the repo's existing theme classes, with no colour codes or pixel values.
- The total, amount financed and total of payments are calculated from the line items and loan terms rather than typed in, so they can't drift from the inputs.
- Every number you gave me checks out:
  - the line items add up to $22,000
  - $20,000 at 6.49% over 240 months comes to $149.00 a month
  - 149 × 240 = $35,760
  - the savings calculation gives $65,080 total and $1,785 the first year

**Worth knowing**
- The savings figure assumes the panels keep producing 11,900 kWh every year (no output loss as they age). It is bill savings only, not savings minus loan costs, and it runs 25 years while the loan runs 20. The page shows these figures side by side and doesn't combine them into a net number.
- I didn't add a "Sign" button because no signing action was specified, and a button that does nothing would mislead the homeowner.

To confirm it works, run `npm run check`.
